nexu-io-opengame-opengame.description: Build, remix, validate, playtest, and publish playable 2D, 3D, and 9:16 browser games with OpenGame. Preview existing game assets in Studio conversations, including models, animations, sprite atlases, maps and sounds. Set up the local OpenGame Studio and stdio MCP connection when missing. Repository development does not trigger game production.

nexu-io-opengame-openmotion.description: Connect, set up, and route to OpenMotion's local Studio and MCP workflows across video, games, HTML design, and multimodal media. Use for OpenMotion installation, onboarding, and first-use discovery; an already-selected domain Skill (openmotion-video, openmotion-game, openmotion-design, openmotion-media) continues directly. Repository development does not trigger production workflows.

nexu-io-opengame-library-openmotion-digi.description: OpenMotion — Plan and produce a digital-human or talking-head presenter video: lock a reusable presenter identity in Workspace Assets, generate sentence-paced narration, drive lip-sync when available (or frame native cutaways and B-roll cleanly when lip-sync is coming soon), overlay editable captions and Motion cards, and support single-sentence partial updates via asset provenance.

nexu-io-opengame-openmotion-game.description: Preview existing game models, animation clips, sprite atlases, maps and sounds in Studio chat. Build, remix, validate and locally publish playable single-player browser games through the OpenMotion game tools, including a consistent art direction and real generated image, music and voice assets when media models are available.

nexu-io-opengame-openmotion-media.description: Discover and run atomic media capabilities (remove-background, relight, image-blend, camera-control, multi-shot, native-audio, speech, music, sound-effects, 3d-asset, 3d-world, asr-transcribe) and standalone image, video, audio or 3D generation through the Unified Capability Center (openmotion_capability_discover, openmotion_capability_run, openmotion_job_manage, openmotion_asset_manage, with openmotion_media_use and openmotion_assets_use retained for compatibility) across configured BYOK providers or a signed-in OpenDesign account. Prefer dedicated capabilityId execution over simulating…

nexu-io-opengame-codex-plugin-onboarding.description: Show the welcome and three embedded project-preview cards; accept automatic MCP activation separately.

nexu-io-opengame-openmotion-video.description: Plan, create, edit, recreate, template-adapt, preview, and export editable motion videos and motion graphics in OpenMotion. Covers original films and creative direction (director), scoped edits and exports on existing projects (production), reference-video recreation (recreate), catalog template browsing and adaptation (template-to-video), and reusable template production (video-to-template). For standalone media assets or atomic capabilities use openmotion-media; for Design Studio HTML prototypes/decks use openmotion-design; for playable games use openmotion-game. nexu-io-opengame-library-openmotion-vide.description: OpenMotion — Localize an existing video into target spoken languages with two coordinated modes: fast one-click dubbing when the dubbing capability is live, or fine-grained timestamped ASR transcription, duration-matched translation, segmented TTS re-voicing and editable bilingual/localized captions in an OpenMotion project.
